name: Circle Game 2
summary: In this universe of Circle Game, Circles have adapted to modern times. This means that the circles know how to make modern furniture, and have took a liking to a warm & cozy feel. If you're looking for a more action-filled experience, try out the PvP gamemode! Otherwise, if you're looking for a more relaxed and slow-paced experience, try the fishing gamemode. Take a look at what is new in this follow-up of Circle Game 1!
